## 4. Gloria H. Balane (only if her affidavit is admitted and she testifies)

| Fact for the record | Ask | Show |
|---|---|---|
| No contact with the owners | Her own S43: "You never communicated with Patricia, Geraldine or Marcia Ellen before the sale?" | Her affidavit |
| Notice before registration | "You signed the Toronto power in May 2020 to defend the property? Before November 2021, did you sign any document calling this land your property?" | Answer, Annex "1". Hold the "my property" SPA for rebuttal; it is her own admission |
